text: The world doesn't just need smarter AI. It needs private AI
people can actually use. Meet Uno One.
Your work deserves privacy. Useful AI should be affordable on the
hardware you already own.
Uno One Power starts with your encrypted local vault. Unlock your
workspace, and work with models running on your own computer.
Chat, research, files, coding, and browser tools share one private workspace,
with permission-controlled actions.
With your permission, connected workflows bring useful context into Uno One.
Here, a WhatsApp summary.
Choose from local models with different capabilities. Uno One keeps the
application, task records, and permissions separate from the model you run.
Hardware-aware execution checks resources, budgets context, and controls model lifecycle to
work within your machine's limits.
Large outputs move into encrypted vault records. The model gets a
bounded preview and retrieval handle. Persistent task history supports recovery.
A quantized twenty-seven billion parameter model ran using eight gigabytes of
GPU memory plus system RAM. A separate cache experiment reduced memory
commitment.
Uno One Mobile brings private assistance to Android, with device controls,
model setup, and a personal workspace.
Blind Aid works without loading the conversational language model. Camera-based object
detection and audio assistance run separately from the chat brain.
Local accessibility, reminders, reviewed phone actions, and documents share one assistant.
A chat model adds capability without gating every useful action.
Reviewed skills include opening apps, document forms, and reading the screen.
Permissions and confirmations remain part of the action path.
Reminders, daily briefings, and dialer handoff stay local. The organizer reports
missing permissions and paused delivery.
See application-reported status for inference, browser tools, audio, vision, documents, and
memory.
Next, private Wi-Fi memory sync connects phone and computer. Smart Deploy
will validate two suitable models for each machine.
Models change. Your work stays yours. Uno One. Private agents for
a private world.
